gpu_tip: ~22GB total at 128K context — the heaviest way to run this sparse-MoE model, but still small enough to fit entirely on a 24GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4090 or RTX 3090), no CPU offload needed. It's a tight fit though; the quantized builds below leave much more headroom.
mac_tip: Needs ~22GB — fits a 24GB MacBook Pro (M4, M4 Pro, M5, or M5 Pro), though it's close to the limit; a 32GB configuration leaves more headroom.
